Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LCSW/LMFT/LMHC) 60K-75K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Belgrade, MT

Salary:

60K - 75K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional "on-call" responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Arizona is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and/or Colorado preferred.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $60,000 – $75,000 / year

Java Software Engineer (Backend)

We are on a mission to help life sciences and healthcare companies focus on what matters to them while we focus on simplifying and removing the friction in shipping.

We have a world-class team at Mercury Teknoloji A.Ş. in Türkiye (with offices in Izmir and Istanbul), a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercury Business Services headquartered in Boston, to develop a state-of-the-art shipping platform that provides the best user experience. Our platform will handle all time-critical and temperature-sensitive shipments as well as express package and freight shipments for life sciences and healthcare companies.

We are seeking a JavaSoftware Engineer (Backend) who is mission-critical in developing the backend of our new shipping platform to support our product initiatives from conception through launch and subsequent iterations. Working with customers across the US, Europe, and Asia, as well as our team, you will be responsible for creating and delivering Mercury signature software products and experiences that meet Mercury clients' needs, goals, and requirements for a seamless shipment experience.

You will report to the Software Engineering Manager, be a member of the cross-functional agile team, and work closely with the Engineering, Product, QA teams. You will collaborate closely with architects, developers, designers, analysts, and testers to ensure that our products are intuitive, easy to use, and convert our customers into raving fans of our shipping technology.

You will:

  • Be a part of the cross-functional agile team contributing to the implementation of Mercury’s next-generation shipment platform by designing, documenting, coding, maintaining, refactoring, fixing, testing, and enjoying what you build.
  • Work closely with a team of Product Managers and Architects to design and implement a scalable, secure, maintainable, and well-documented API platform for our clients.
  • Work with DevOps engineers to design and test build pipelines, and to design and help code tools and scripts for deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with Architects and DevOps engineers to design and/or code event data collection, notifications, and filters for observability
  • Work with architects and front-end developers to establish microservices and APIs.
  • Collaborate with the QA team to determine the best testing strategy, toolset, and QA practices for your backend production.
  • Work in the Backend Chapter to ensure you continuously improve implementation practices, tech stack, standards, and third-party tools across all production teams.
  • Collaborate with the Product Team in Boston, MA, to influence product requirements and the roadmap.
  • Work with the Engineering team to ensure technical needs are met while maintaining a strong focus on usability.
  • Conduct developer research with the client developers of the platform and our internal team.
  • Advocate for and be the voice of Mercury’s customers in our product development process.
  • Distill complex problems and propose simple, elegant solutions.
  • Create a signature experience for the Mercury shipping platform that is aligned with our brand values.

You have/are:

  • Fluent in English.
  • Bachelor's degree in a software-focused engineering field such as

Computer Engineering,

Software Engineering,

Electrical and Electronics Engineering,

Computer Science and Engineering

  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to work with other developers and assist team members.
  • Passion for learning and researching. Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies to ensure our applications are current and competitive.
  • 4-7 years of experience in backend development with Java, with at least 3+ years using version 9+
  • Strong core Java fundamentals
  • Minimum 2 years of recent experience with Spring Boot / Spring.
  • Proficiency with Spring Data, Hibernate, and JPA
  • Experience with unit testing and test-driven development
  • Experience in code review (both as a reviewer and developer) and a willingness to participate.
  • Familiarity with Git and distributed version control systems.
  • Knowledge of RESTful API design and implementation.
  • Knowledge of backend architectural design concepts. Proven experience with microservices architecture.
  • Experience with Kafka for messaging and streaming.
  • Understanding of database technologies, particularly PostgreSQL.
  • Profound understanding of basic development technologies like OAuth, REST, JWT.
  • Understanding of OOP principles and solid algorithms and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience building large-scale backends with supporting developer portals/marketplaces.
  • Good understanding of lean/agile values, principles, and associated practices.
  • Good understanding of Linux operating system shell commands and scripting.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and in a team.
  • Ability to prioritize customer needs and deliver promptly.

We appreciate it as a bonus if you have:

  • Master or higher studies in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related fields.
  • Experience with other databases or data storage technologies and NoSQL.
  • Experience and deep understanding of Observability tools and systems.
  • Knowledge of Docker and container orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes)
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with Quarkus and GraalVM ecosystem
  • Experience with Hexagonal Architecture (Ports and Adapters)

We offer:

  • Competitive salary in USD.
  • Remote work in working hours in Turkey.
  • Private health insurance covers you and your immediate family.
  • 20 days of paid holidays including the first year of employment.
  • Having your birthdays off work.

You have a clear vision of where your career can go. And we have the leadership to help you get there. At CNA, we strive to create a culture in which people know they matter and are part of something important, ensuring the abilities of all employees are used to their fullest potential.

CNA’s National Accounts Casualty, Large Casualty team provides primary casualty insurance products such as General Liability, Commercial Auto, and Workers’ Compensation to large businesses. Our National Accounts team underwrites a diverse mix of business and industry classes including Manufacturing, Professional Services, Construction, Financial Institutions, Healthcare, Real-estate, Distributors, Technology, Wholesale, and Retail. Typical account sizes start at $500,000 and up in premium on a multi-line basis and works with national brokers.

Under general supervision is responsible for the timely and accurate processing of new and renewal insurance applications. Partnering with Underwriters on all aspects of the Underwriting function including providing the necessary information to allow for UW to make prudent underwriting decisions. Provides high-level support to underwriters.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Performs a combination of duties in accordance with departmental guidelines:
  • Within designated authority and following established procedures, performs routine selection, evaluation, and pricing of the least complex risks.
  • Assists underwriters by communicating with agencies on routine matters.
  • Requests underwriting and/or state mandated requirements, based on guidelines.
  • Performs data entry of insurance application, including verification of information provided and compliance to state requirements.
  • Issues and assembles policies upon receipt of underwriter approval.
  • Upon request from underwriters, processes cancellations, declinations and reissues of policies.
  • Upon request from underwriters, may review underwriting requirements and may recommend acceptance or denial utilizing preset procedures.
  • May provide assistance and/or training to other Underwriting Technicians.
  • May assist in special project work.
  • May update the underwriting system.

Reporting Relationship

Supervisor or Manager

Skills, Knowledge and Abilities

  • Knowledge of policy processing procedures and documentation.
  • Knowledge of applicable insurance products.
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work at high levels of productivity and quality.
  • Ability to work independently on multiple tasks.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite as well as other business-related software.

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma, GED or equivalent experience. Some college preferred.
  • Typically a minimum three years of related work experience in an office environment.

This position has the potential to be filled at a Sr. Underwriting Technician level based on experience.

Salary determinations are based on various factors, including but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and location. raw.description:
Overview

Lynker Corporation is a leading provider of innovative solutions in ocean science and exploration. With a commitment to excellence and a passion for innovation, Lynker leverages cutting-edge technologies and scientific expertise to support the creation and delivery of improved operational weather forecasts. As part of our ongoing growth and expansion, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Education and Outreach Specialist to join our growing team.

Responsibilities

Duties will include the following:

Professional Development / Outreach Training You will provide instructional and design leadership to implement a national educator professional development program across online, onsite, and hybrid platforms to enhance ocean literacy and advance agency mission objectives.
  • Program Design and Coordination: Providing the instructional and design leadership for national educator Professional Development (PD) effort (online/onsite/hybrid), including program/presentation design, agendas, content, and videos; designing, coordinating, and delivering national NOAA Ocean Exploration professional learning and professional development opportunities for educators (online, hybrid, and/or onsite) to advance NOAA Ocean Exploration mission objectives and exploration science subject matter. This work includes developing objectives and agendas, developing workshop materials (including design and development of presentations, handouts, supply guides, etc.), curating NOAA Ocean Exploration content (multimedia, expeditions, fact sheets, lessons, etc.), communicating workshop priorities, needs, and expectations with all relevant internal and external partners, and creating informational and promotional materials for educator opportunities; including education content development, product graphic design, and outreach promotion.
  • Network Management: Work with a network of Professional Development Facilitators; maintaining and training a network of internal and external workshop facilitators (5 minimum); work with the Education Team Lead as a TPOC to identify new facilitators (i.e., Host Partner recruitment) and meet workshop implementation needs (planning, logistics, promotion, implementation, and instruction); leading facilitator training and monitoring meetings to ensure consistency of all NOAA Ocean Exploration educator opportunities across the country; and executing the training of Ocean Exploration and Research Facilitators.
  • Partnership and Liaison Coordination: Serving as the Alliance Partner site coordinator liaison (onsite PD/online PD); and coordinating with the Education Team Lead and Outreach and Education Division Chief (TPOCs) to cultivate and establish new Alliance Partnerships with science institutions including, but not limited to, aquaria, museums, universities, and other informal science centers in coordination with the COR and/or applicable TPOC(s) and coordinating, preparing, and executing planned ocean education partner meeting logistics (both onsite and virtual) including agendas and meeting minutes.
  • Execution and Evaluation: Regularly presenting workshops and promoting offerings; overseeing advertising; designing, promoting, and executing ocean exploration topical education webinars/presentations in coordination with the COR and/or applicable TPOC(s); and executing and guiding PD evaluation(s) and summative workshop evaluations.
  • Workshop and Course Management: Managing Professional Development Workshops for educators in the use of Learning Ocean Science through Ocean Exploration curriculum in accordance with Government-approved deadlines; and providing program management for development, design, and execution of online EX teacher professional development courses in cooperation with the College of Exploration.
  • Outreach and Web Services: Coordinating with graphics designers and national partners to develop workshop announcements and post to Ocean Exploration Educator listserv, The BRIDGE, and National Science Teachers Association (NSTA) Building a Presence for Science listservs; and coordinating with the NOAA National Ocean Service Special Projects Team to keep the Professional Development offering and Education Alliance page up to date on the OE website.
  • Project Coordination: Collaborating with the NOAA Office of Ocean Exploration and Research to provide project coordination, program, and technical services for education products and activities that engage educators, students, and the general public, enhancing America’s ocean literacy through the excitement of ocean expeditions, exploration and discovery.

Outreach and Partnerships

You will provide technical and administrative services for the management of existing alliances and the development of new educational partnerships and programs.

  • Alliance Partnership Management: Maintaining the Alliance Partnership by coordinating with the Director of Education of OER (TPOC) to manage, track, and document financial agreements with the National Marine Sanctuary Foundation and establish new alliance partnerships.
  • Education Program Development: Preparing and coordinating with the Director of Education of OER (TPOC) and national partners to develop an education outreach program to advance the NOAA Ship Okeanos Explorer expeditions and telepresence capability and performing expedition education outreach in the community

Education / Outreach Product Development

You will provide technical and administrative services for the creation, management, and refinement of educational materials and digital content.

  • Content Management and Gap Analysis: Establishing, curating, and maintaining a storage management system for all historic and current education content; identifying gaps in current content and priorities for the development of new materials.
  • Education Product Development: Planning, coordinating, and executing the development of education products—including coordinating the technical inputs of external partners—that meet contemporary classroom needs, standards, and instructional methods.
  • Brand Identity and Graphic Design Services: Coordinating the development of a unique brand identity for NOAA Ocean Exploration for education products produced in print and shared online;
  • performing the graphic design of new educational materials and performing technical reviews of the work of external partners.
  • Translation and Evaluation Coordination: Executing education and outreach product translations, including consulting and coordinating with regional language and local dialect experts and performing technical reviews of work completed by external partners; identifying resource evaluation needs and coordinating the workflow of external evaluators in coordination with the COR and/or applicable TPOC(s)

Education / Outreach Strategy and Programmatic Growth

You will provide technical and administrative services for the development, implementation, and expansion of education and outreach strategies.

  • Education Strategy and Implementation: Executing education strategy development and implementation to advance the NOAA Ocean Exploration and NOAA Education Strategic Plans; analyzing the education landscape and educator needs; performing evaluation of current education product development, educator training, and ocean exploration education communication approaches; identifying gaps in current education offerings; and formulating novel promotion and outreach approaches to expand the reach and utility of NOAA Ocean Exploration education offerings.
  • Promotion and Communications Strategy: Coordinating the development and execution of a promotion strategy for sharing NOAA Ocean Exploration expedition updates and discoveries, education products, and educator and student opportunities to a national educator audience (and international where relevant) using communications tools such as, but not limited to email, social media, NOAA Ocean Exploration and Deep Ocean Education Project websites, conference presentations, and educator newsletters; providing prompt updates for the NOAA Ocean Exploration website as education products and educator opportunities arise; strategically growing the ocean education audience.
  • Educational Outreach Material Development: Planning, developing, maintaining, and executing lists of educational outreach materials and needed supplies, and related activities to achieve NOAA Ocean Exploration outreach and engagement priorities; initiating and planning projects, including requirements and resourcing needs documents, that lead to innovative, new approaches to communicating information about ocean exploration to education-specific audiences.
  • Expedition Education Coverage: Executing expedition education coverage through the implementation of modernized web-based approaches and the delivery of technical and administrative services for Ocean Exploration Education outreach events and presentations.

Qualifications

The Ideal candidate will have the following:

Education and Prior Experience:■ Bachelor’s degree in Science Education, Curriculum Development, or a related field; OR a degree inmarine/ocean science-related field with professional experience as an educator, outreach specialist, or program coordinator in a formal or informal education setting.■ Deep understanding of oceanography, marine ecosystems, and current marine technology.■ Demonstrated experience developing age-appropriate educational materials or programming (lessons,readings, videos, etc) that support national formal education standards and instructional strategies (e.g.,NGSS, Ocean Literacy, phenomenon-based learning).

○ Core Competencies:■ Ability to translate complex scientific data, technology, and discoveries into clear, engaging materials fordiverse audiences.■ Ability to manage the full product development lifecycle, work with external contractors, establish projectmilestones, monitor deliverables, and provide timely feedback.■ Ability to lead collaborative education initiatives with interagency partners, cooperative institutes, and ocean education networks.■ Practical understanding of Section 508 compliance standards for digital materials and experience coordinating web-posting workflows for online educational collections.

○ Desirable Soft Skills:■ Strong oral and written communication skills across diverse audiences.■ Excellent interpersonal and collaborative skills with internal and external stakeholders.■ Proven ability to adapt quickly to evolving program requirements and agency priorities.■ Demonstrated critical thinking and proactive problem solving skills.■ Excellent time management and organizational skills.■ Demonstrated initiative and self-direction in managing assigned program areas.■ Strong attention to detail when reviewing drafts, enforcing visual/content consistency, and ensuring compliance with federal standards.■ Ability to work effectively both independently and as a collaborative team member.

○ Travel & Work Conditions:■ This is a 100% remote position (full-time telework). The selectee will perform their duties from an approved alternative worksite anywhere within the United States

■ Occasional travel is required (5+ trips annually). The selected candidate must be willing and able to travel to lead regional and national educator professional development workshops, facilitate classroom testing and product feedback cycles, and present program initiatives at professional educational or scientific conferences.● Due to frequent travel obligations, proximity to a major commercial airport is highly preferred tofacilitate efficient and cost-effective official travel

About Lynker

Lynker is a growing, employee owned business, specializing in professional, scientific and technical services. Our continually expanding team combines scientific expertise with mature, results-driven processes and tools to achieve technically sound, cost effective solutions in hydrology/water sciences, geospatial analysis, information technology, resource management, conservation, and management and business process improvement.

We focus on putting the right people in the right place to be effective. And having the right people is critical for success. Our streamlined organization enables and empowers our talented professionals to tackle our customers' scientific and technical priorities – creatively and effectively.

Lynker offers a team-oriented work environment, and the opportunity to work in a culture of exceptionally skilled professionals who embrace sound science and creative solutions. Lynker's benefits include the following:

  • Comprehensive healthcare for the employee at no monthly cost
  • Healthcare benefit covers medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision
  • Personal Time Off (PTO) Policy plus paid holidays
  • Highly competitive compensation plan regularly calibrated against industry and location benchmarks
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company-matching
  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) – we're all company owners!
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • Short- and long-term disability insurance
  • Life and accident insurance
  • Tuition assistance/Training/Workforce improvement reimbursement per year
  • Spot bonuses for exceptional performance
  • Annual Employee Recognition Awards with bonuses
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Free centralized, self-directed Learning Management System to learn at your own pace

raw.description:
Life is too short to work with jerks.

Join our team at NCD, a top-tier insurance provider, consisting of a unique and eclectic group of winners, nerds, and gamers who balance a fun, kind, and thoughtful approach to life with an unwavering commitment to unparalleled member satisfaction. Our ecosystem is rooted in our five core values: Relentless Positivity, Growth Obsessed, Get it Done, Helpful Spirit, and Solution Driven.

We are not just coworkers, but a community, working tirelessly towards 'Spreading the Smile' to our members, agents, and each other. NCD is at the forefront of dental and vision insurance, in partnership with our carrier partners MetLife, VSP, and Zurich. Our continuous growth is a testament to our commitment to delivering outstanding agent and customer satisfaction.

If you are ready to win each day, are eager to grow, and aspire to contribute to an organization that is setting the pace in the industry, then we are looking for you. Together, let’s drive change and take NCD to new heights. Join us and become a vital part of our success story as we continue to transform lives and 'Spread the Smile.

The Role

NCD is hiring a dedicated recruiter who will own the recruiting function from end to end. You'll be the primary driver of hiring across the company: sourcing, screening, interview process design, offer negotiation, and everything in between. You'll continue to improve our hiring processes, while partnering closely with hiring managers and executives across our various departments.

We're looking for someone who's comfortable with high volume, high ownership, and minimal hand-holding. You'll have autonomy to improve upon processes and real accountability for whether it's working. Because NCD is a lean, growing organization, this role has direct, regular visibility with senior executives on hiring strategy, key searches, and organizational design decisions.

What You'll Own

  • Full-cycle recruiting — from intake to offer, across all departments and levels.
  • Process design — continuously refine sourcing strategy, interview kits, scorecards, and workflows suited to a growing company in a regulated industry.
  • Stakeholder partnership — work directly with hiring managers to define roles, calibrate interview panels, and keep candidates moving without sacrificing quality.
  • Executive visibility — brief senior leadership directly on key searches, hiring strategy, and org design decisions, rather than routing through layers of management.
  • Pipeline & sourcing — proactively source passive candidates rather than relying on inbound alone; build a bench for recurring or hard-to-fill roles.
  • Systems & reporting — manage the ATS and recruiting tools within NCD's Rippling-based HR environment; track time-to-fill, pipeline health, and hiring manager satisfaction, and report on it proactively.
  • Offer management — lead negotiation and close, coordinating with hiring manager and HR/Finance on compensation and start-date logistics respectively.
  • Candidate experience — represent NCD professionally to every candidate, regardless of outcome.

What Success Looks Like

  • Recruiting runs as a self-sustaining system, not a series of one-off fire drills.
  • Hiring managers trust the process because it's fast and transparent.
  • Time-to-fill and quality-of-hire metrics improve quarter over quarter.
  • Bottlenecks get flagged and fixed before someone has to ask.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including time spent building or significantly improving a recruiting process.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously. Comfortable fully owning recruiting.
  • Strong cross-functional stakeholder management, including the ability to push back on a hiring manager's request when it won't get them the candidate they actually want.
  • Hands-on ATS/HRIS experience.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.

Pluses/Preferred:

  • Recruiting experience in insurance, health care, financial services, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience recruiting technical and executive level roles.
  • Experience recruiting for a company undergoing high growth and increasing complexity in needs.

NCD Benefits

  • Company-paid health, dental, life, and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Opportunity for professional development
  • Work from home allowance and support
  • Positive work environment
  • Remote, office-based flexibility within the United States of America

Equal Opportunity

NCD is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe our differences make us stronger and help us better serve our members, agents, partners, and each other.

raw.description:
Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC) $60K-$85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Cuyahoga Falls, OH

Salary:

60K - 85K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With two convenient locations in Colorado and growing, OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and work-site location(s). Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available location. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW) in the state of Colorado with the ability to practice independently is required.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $60,000 – $85,000 / year

raw.title: Onboarding Cloud Accountant (Remote, Canada)
raw.excerpt: This is a remote-based opportunity from anywhere in Canada ABOUT AMLBAMLB is a progressive virtual Chief Financial Officer (CFO) business that enables clients and team members to reach their potential.
raw.description:
This is a remote-based opportunity from anywhere in Canada

ABOUT AMLB

AMLB is a progressive virtual Chief Financial Officer (CFO) business that enables clients and team members to reach their potential. We partner with growing businesses and not-for-profit organizations across Canada, combining cloud technology with proactive financial advice to help our clients succeed.

THE POSITION

The Onboarding Cloud Accountant owns the first chapter of the client journey at AMLB and is responsible for leading new clients through onboarding and setting them up for long-term success.

You will work closely with clients to transform incomplete, disorganized, or inefficient accounting processes into scalable cloud-based systems and workflows. You will coordinate onboarding engagements, resolve historical accounting issues, implement best practices, and ensure a seamless transition into AMLB's ongoing service model.

As AMLB continues to grow, this role is expected to evolve into a specialized onboarding position focused on implementation, process improvement, and client transition excellence. This is a unique opportunity to help shape and build AMLB's onboarding function from the ground up.

Initially, the role is expected to operate in an approximate 50/50 structure:

• 50% Client Onboarding & Implementation – Lead approximately four new client onboardings per month (approximately eight active onboarding engagements based on an average 60-day onboarding cycle). Responsibilities include accounting clean-up, system implementation, workflow design, project management, and transitioning clients to AMLB's recurring service model.

• 50% Recurring Cloud Accounting – Support a limited portfolio of approximately 8–10 recurring clients to maintain technical expertise, support team capacity, and remain connected to AMLB's ongoing service model.

As onboarding demand increases, recurring client responsibilities will gradually decrease, allowing the role to become increasingly focused on onboarding, implementation, and continuous improvement.

THE PRIORITIES

Client Onboarding & Implementation

Lead onboarding engagements from kickoff through transition, coordinating accounting clean-up, system implementation, client communication, and handoff to the recurring service team.

Accounting Quality & Advisory

Review historical financial information, resolve accounting issues, establish reliable reporting processes, and provide practical recommendations that support client success.

Onboarding Operations & Continuous Improvement

Improve onboarding workflows, templates, documentation, SOPs, metrics, and client experience while leveraging technology and AI. Provide input into onboarding capacity planning and future resource requirements.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead client onboarding engagements from kickoff through transition to ongoing service.
  • Develop onboarding plans, timelines, and client action items.
  • Review, reconcile, and organize historical accounting records.
  • Complete catch-up and clean-up accounting projects.
  • Configure and optimize cloud accounting systems and related applications.
  • Coordinate onboarding activities across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prepare onboarding documentation, SOPs, process maps, and transition summaries.
  • Monitor onboarding timelines, metrics, and project status, identifying bottlenecks and recommending improvements.
  • Analyze onboarding workload and provide recommendations to support onboarding capacity planning.
  • Support a limited portfolio of recurring cloud accounting clients.
  • Prepare financial reporting packages and support sales tax compliance activities.
  • Utilize AI and technology tools to improve efficiency, consistency, and client outcomes.

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 5+ years of Canadian cloud accounting, bookkeeping, or accounting experience.
  • CPA designation is considered an asset but is not required.
  • Strong QuickBooks Online and cloud accounting technology experience.
  • Experience with accounting clean-up, conversions, implementations, or client onboarding is considered an asset.
  • Exceptional project management and organizational skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple client projects simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced remote environment.
  • Experience working with not-for-profit organizations is considered an asset.

THE ATTRACTIONS

  • Competitive compensation of $85,000-$95,000 plus up to a 12% annual performance bonus.
  • Comprehensive, cost-shared benefits package, cell phone allowance, laptop, and $500 home office allowance.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible hours and half-days on Fridays in August.
  • Opportunity to help build and shape AMLB's onboarding function.
  • Exposure to leading cloud accounting technology and AI tools, including ChatGPT Plus and Claude.
  • Ongoing coaching, mentorship, and professional development.
  • Direct exposure to entrepreneurs, executive teams, and not-for-profit leaders across Canada.
Salary: 85,000 - 95,000 CAD annually

raw.title: Business Development - Regional Sales Manager

raw.description:
Infinite Electronics is a leading GLOBAL SUPPLIER of electronic components, serving the urgent needs of Regional Sales Managers through a family of highly recognized and trusted brands. We offer a wide range of products, backed by world-class technical support. Our brands provide solutions with power distribution, surge protection, RF, cables, transceivers, fiber solutions, connectors, and antenna solutions. Infinite serves various markets, including telecommunications, commercial, industrial, factory automation, military, energy, MSO, and data centers, among others.

Position Description:

As the Regional Sales Manager you will be responsible for planning and implementing strategies and operations across the US, including the support, coordination, and performance management of manufacturers’ representatives within assigned territories. The candidate must have 7 years or more experience selling. Additionally, you will manage your staff consisting of at least one ISR and FAE, partner with manufacturers’ representatives to drive territory growth, and work closely with other departments within the company i.e., Channel Management. The right candidate will be a self-motivated professional with proven managerial experience and an outstanding history leading outside business development, regional sales teams, and representative sales channels. This professional is accountable for all strategies, initiatives, actions, and revenue-driving activities. This role will oversee daily operations, optimize team efficiency, ensure KPIs are met, support representative engagement and accountability, and drive sales growth. In addition to being an excellent communicator, the ideal candidate will also demonstrate exceptional coaching and leadership skills to deliver profitable revenue growth.

General Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute strategic plans to achieve sales targets and company goals.
  • Responsible for planning, developing, and managing the Rep Organization, Inside Sales, Channel Sales for revenue growth year over year.
  • Support and manage manufacturers’ representatives by providing sales direction, product training, account strategy, pipeline visibility, and regular communication to maximize territory performance.
  • Support and help manage Channel Sales operations, by providing sales direction, account transition product training, account strategy, pipeline visibility, and regular communication to maximize territory performance.
  • Establish strong relationships and communication frameworks across all company functions and drive cross-functional collaboration and coordination with all departments to support and execute strategic initiatives and tactical business plans.
  • Conduct effective resource planning to maximize the productivity of resources (people, technology, etc.).
  • Prepare sales reports, KPI data, and sales team performance for upper management.
  • Monitor manufacturers’ representative performance against sales goals, customer engagement, opportunity development, and forecast accuracy.
  • Maintains professional and technical knowledge by tracking emerging trends, attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, benchmarking state-of-the-art practices, and participating in professional societies.
  • Hire, coach, and train personnel to maintain high customer service standards.
  • Develop and promote weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales objectives with weekly one-on-one meetings and bi-weekly pipeline review.
  • Lead sales team quarterly reviews with top customers to develop forecasts and identify opportunities and trends.
  • Strong mentoring, coaching, and leadership development skills.
  • Design and implement sales compensation plans aligned with industry’s best practices and benchmarks.
  • Embody and champion Infinite’s culture, values, and behaviors of Positive Urgency, Accountability, Ownership, Same-day Responsiveness, Collaboration, and Solution Orientation.
  • Ability to work from home (WFH), potential hybrid office environment, and travel as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned are to support overall sales objectives but may not be limited to the above list.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Candidates will have strong people management and development skills to mentor, coach, and motivate others.
  • Candidate will have strong people skills and business acumen with a customer-centric focus.
  • Professional communication skills, written and spoken English.
  • Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Experience with CRM and ERP systems preferred.
  • Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
  • General computer skills, including solid working knowledge of Excel, Word, Outlook, MS Teams, PowerPoint, Call center software, phone systems.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum of seven plus years of experience leading business development and regional sales.
  • Proven history of revenue growth of 10% or greater annually.

Personal Traits and Characteristics:

  • Strategic, structured thinker with strong analytical skills and business acumen. Aptitude for framing business questions with data, translating business needs into strategies, and executing tactics and process improvements.
  • Strong collaborator with exceptional interpersonal and influence skills.
  • Ability to negotiate priorities across organizations at all levels with competing priorities.
  • Effective, clear, and concise communication and comprehension skills, verbal and written. Ability to communicate the right level of information to executives and cross-functional teams at the right cadence.
  • Energetic participant in leadership discussions around all areas of the business.
  • Clear understanding of the importance of company culture.
  • Resolute, dependable, and diligent
  • Highly organized with good time management skills
  • Task-oriented, diligence, ability to multitask and prioritize.
  • Able to work under pressure and deadlines.
  • Professional demeanor, dress, and conduct in a business office setting.
  • The successful candidate shall exhibit a sense of ownership and urgency and be solution-oriented, collaborative, and accountable.

Physical Job Requirements:

This position requires working in both office and warehouse environments. Duties involve sitting, standing, walking, and using a computer for extended periods while preparing reports, analyzing data, conducting audits, and managing quality processes. The employee may occasionally bend, reach, stoop, or lift up to 25 pounds when performing inspections or reviewing materials. Visual ability to read computer screens, reports, labels, and technical documents is required, along with the ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and virtually. The role may require occasional travel and exposure to varying temperatures, moderate noise, dust, and other conditions common in warehouse and production environments. Candidates must be able to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

Work Environment:

The work environment is remote during regular or extended business hours.

Accommodation:

Candidates should be able to perform essential duties in the work environment described by or without reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform basic functions.

Equal Employment Opportunity Infinite Electronics is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are committed to building a diverse workforce and actively encourage women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and veterans to apply for positions.

About NexGen Virtual Workplace:

NexGen Virtual Workplace is a forward-thinking global SaaS company leading the charge in elevating remote and hybrid work models. Our innovative virtual business management platform brings the experience of 'in-office' collaboration to every corner of the world, enabling togetherness and promoting productivity across dispersed teams.

Job Description:

We are looking for a dynamic Director of Strategic & Channel Relationships/sales/marketing, who is skilled at building and nurturing key relationships with business partners and stakeholders. The ideal candidate will utilize their strategic acumen and relationship-building prowess to expand our network and create synergies that drive mutual growth and success.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategic Relationship Management: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key business partners and stakeholders, ensuring mutual success and continuous growth.

2. Strategic Planning & Execution: Craft and implement strategic plans for partnerships, aligning them with NexGen Virtual's overall business objectives.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field; an MBA is preferred.
  • Proven experience in a strategic relationship role or similar position, ideally in a SaaS and CcaaS environment.
  • Excellent relationship management and strategic planning skills.
  • Strong analytical abilities and a data-driven approach to decision-making.
  • Superior interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in using CRM software and other business software.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team-oriented environment.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial setting.

Must have:

  • Experience in the Contact Center, BPO and SaaS industry.
  • Familiarity with remote work platforms and collaboration tools.

Proven track record of navigating complex business situations and achieving positive outcomes

Salary: $80,000 to $100,000

title: Senior Assembly Process Engineer
description: NVIDIA's GPUs and SoCs are world leaders in power, performance and efficiency.

raw.title: Senior Assembly Process Engineer
raw.excerpt: NVIDIA's GPUs and SoCs are world leaders in power, performance and efficiency.
raw.description:
NVIDIA's GPUs and SoCs are world leaders in power, performance and efficiency. We are continually innovating to deliver new and creative solutions to extraordinary problems in a wide range of sectors. To this purpose, we are seeking a passionate and experienced Senior CoWoS Assembly Engineer who is committed to making a difference in the world through their contributions. You will be responsible for development of CoWoS Assembly process & material for NVIDIA's next generation products as part of the Advanced Technology Group (ATG).

Do you have a strong background in CoWoS (S, L and R)? Are you proficient in one of the related fields, such as System on Integrated Chips, CoWoS design or Hybrid bonding technology ? If yes, then we’d love to hear from you! The job requires working on complex problems and building advanced products; you will be providing solutions that are highly creative and directly contribute to product differentiation.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead CoWoS assembly tool & process development for NVIDIA’s next generation CoWoS products and platforms.
  • Responsible for building & deploying high volume CoWoS assembly tool and qualifying CoWoS assembly line for scale up of Nvidia’s CoWoS products and platforms.
  • Responsible for defining tool architecture, tool features and functions, develop stable processes for CoWoS platforms (include S, L, and R), define assembly flow and own assembly quality and reliability.
  • Work closely with Fab and assembly OSATs deploy and qualify CoWoS process across high volume manufacturing.
  • Work closely with internal design, fabrication and packaging cross-functional teams to develop new assembly requirements, assembly flows, help with design of different test structures, share data, and lead new assembly processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement in assembly yield and assembly quality/reliability.

What we need to see:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics or related fields with equivalent experience.
  • 12+ years CoWoS experience.
  • Strong background & experience in CoWoS design, CoWoS process, fabrication, test, and assembly.
  • Hands-on experience in CoWoS development, especially CoWoS-L and CoWoS-R process, building and qualifying CoWoS assembly process and analyzing assembly data.
  • Strong statistical analysis skills – ability to use data visualization techniques to deliver assembly data analysis and optimizing manufacturing techniques
  • Understanding of quality control, statistical process control and DOE techniques
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience in CoWoS design or fabrication, including familiarity with CoWoS structure
  • Solid understanding of AutoCad, or other software tools
  • Mechanical simulation software like Ansys mechanical.

NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and self-driven engineer with real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

title: Technical Customer Success Manager (m/f/d) - EMEA

raw.title: Technical Customer Success Manager (m/f/d) - EMEA
raw.excerpt: Aras is a leader in product lifecycle management (PLM) and digital thread solutions.
raw.description:
Aras is a leader in product lifecycle management (PLM) and digital thread solutions. As one of the fastest growing PLM companies, our technology enables the rapid delivery of flexible solutions built on a powerful digital thread backbone and a low-code development platform.

Our platform and PLM applications connect users in all disciplines to critical product data and processes across the lifecycle and throughout the extended supply chain. The world’s largest manufacturers are leveraging Aras Innovator to manage their complex product lifecycles to improve production timelines, meet and exceed revenue growth targets, and accelerate innovation. We collaborate with companies in some of the most innovative industries, including automotive, industrial/heavy equipment, aerospace and defense, and high-tech electronics.

About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Customer Success Manager to support our EMEA region, combining strong technical acumen with a customer-centric mindset to ensure subscribers achieve long-term value from the Aras Innovator platform. This role bridges the gap between Customer Success and Pre-Sales: you will not only drive adoption, renewals, and expansion, but also act as the technical anchor within your accounts — diagnosing issues, clarifying root causes, and translating complex technical topics into clear guidance for both business and IT stakeholders. You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Professional Services, Support, and Product Management across EMEA to ensure a seamless and technically sound customer experience.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Act as the trusted technical advisor for Aras subscribers across the EMEA region, driving adoption, business outcomes, and long-term value realization of the Aras Innovator platform.
  • Analyze, triage, and help resolve technical issues raised by customers, working closely with Support and Engineering to ensure timely and effective solutions.
  • Conduct technical health checks, architecture reviews, and platform assessments to proactively identify risks before they impact customer satisfaction.
  • Coach subscribers on PLM best practices, configuration approaches, and system optimization.
  • Facilitate and own technical escalations, ensuring the right internal resources are engaged and customers stay on track.
  • Partner with subscribers to understand technical requirements, map them to platform capabilities, and identify expansion opportunities (e.g. additional modules, integrations, use cases).
  • Support renewal and expansion activities by providing technical validation and building confidence in the platform’s ability to meet evolving needs.
  • Build trusted relationships with key technical and business stakeholders and lead regular business/technical reviews to measure progress toward objectives.
  • Develop technical tools, templates, and best practices to help subscribers succeed with Aras Innovator.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Pre-Sales, Professional Services, and Support across the EMEA region to ensure smooth handovers and a consistent customer experience across the lifecycle.

Who You Are

  • A technically curious, customer-focused professional who is equally comfortable in a whiteboard architecture discussion and a business value conversation.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset — able to independently investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and communicate solutions clearly.

raw.excerpt: About Generation:At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives.
raw.description:
About Generation:

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have an 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

About the role:

  • Job duration: This is a 12 months fixed-term contract
  • Location requirements: Remote (with reliable WiFi), based in Colombia. Availability to travel within Colombia and attend in-person events
  • Start date: November 2026
  • End date: October 2027

What will you do:

The Program Coordinator will coordinate the execution of training phase logistics and operational activities across Generation Colombia programs. This role may also deliver assigned operational support to mobilization processes, as required.

Main Responsibilities

  • Act as the main point of contact for learners, responding to learner inquiries, tracking requests, and escalating issues according to defined protocols.
  • Execute learner onboarding activities (“Day 0”) by preparing onboarding sessions, validating learner readiness requirements, and documenting attendance and commitment prior to “Day 1.”
  • Support day-to-day program delivery in collaboration with the C&I Coordinator by monitoring learner experience and tracking TSP operational execution when applicable.
  • Identify, document, and support resolution of operational risks and issues by applying troubleshooting actions and supporting the implementation of mitigation plans.
  • Track learner progress, engagement, and outcomes by maintaining monitoring tools, producing interim performance reports, and developing improvement recommendations.
  • Execute learner stipend and resource distribution processes (laptops, internet access, cameras, and economic support) ensuring transparency and timely delivery.
  • Monitor correct use of resources and compliance with program policies.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot outcomes, create interim reports and make recommendations for operational improvements
  • Support mentorship process execution by tracking participation, identifying dropout risks, and documenting actions to improve retention and graduation outcomes.
  • Participate in weekly calls to troubleshoot learners’ outcomes and plan for extra support if needed
  • Execute periodic TSP performance review activities by preparing inputs, documenting mentorship and operational delivery status, and tracking performance against academic and operational KPIs
  • Conduct regular check-ins with TSP teams to review progress, risks, quality of instruction, and learner performance.
  • Identify and escalate TSP-related risks and performance gaps by documenting findings and supporting corrective action planning and follow-up.
  • Support the execution of complementary formative workshops by coordinating logistics and tracking delivery with partner companies.
  • Execute cohort outcome support activities in collaboration with Learner Support Services by completing cohort risk analysis and individual learner readiness assessments.

Additionally, as part of placement support within the in-program sessions this role might:

  • Support the BD & Partnerships team in employability activities during the in-program phase and ensure a structured and smooth handover to the placement team
  • Execute learner preparation activities for transition into placement, ensuring data, profiles, and readiness of all learners are complete
  • Support event planning and employability engagement activities with learners

About you:

  • Bachelor's degree in any field with a solid academic record.
  • 3-5 years of experience in program coordination, preferably in a nonprofit, start-up, or social enterprise environment
  • Strong communication skills. Demonstrated fluency with Spanish and English speaking and writing skills
  • Experience developing program procedures and resources, with keen attention to detail
  • Experience managing teams, project managing tasks, and coordinating stakeholders
  • Entrepreneurial and proactive mindset to deliver against targets and seek opportunities for improvement and growth
  • Results-driven and able to quantify success by developing metrics/analytics
  • Ability to operate independently while also being a team player
  • Belief in Generation’s mission, preferably with experience working with disadvantaged communities
  • Demonstrated commitment to equity and social impact work
  • The candidate should be open to traveling to Generation sites as per the needs of the program

Who We Are

Brandlive is a global technology and services company specialising in high-quality virtual and hybrid events, webcasting and digital experiences. We combine a purpose-built technology platform with production expertise, creative services and hands-on support to help organisations deliver engaging communications at scale.

BrandTV is the evolution of that capability into an enterprise video and communications ecosystem designed to make important communications more engaging, polished and valuable. It brings together live streaming, on-demand video, production, creative and expert support to help organisations create experiences employees want to watch — rather than another meeting they have to attend.

The Role

The Account Executive - New Logo is responsible solely for winning new business for BrandTV. This is a net-new sales role focused on identifying, qualifying, progressing and closing new enterprise opportunities across a global market. The Account Executive will partner closely with the New Logo Hunter / BDR and Sales Director to convert targeted accounts into qualified opportunities and signed customers.

The Account Executive owns the sales process from qualified opportunity through close, including discovery, stakeholder mapping, consultative selling, demonstrations, proposals, commercial negotiation and contract close. They will build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers, understand the customer's business and communications challenges, and articulate the value of BrandTV across its platform, production, creative and content ecosystem.

Following a successful close, the Account Executive will remain the commercial owner during an initial onboarding / transition period, typically 6–12 months, working with the Account Director and Customer Success Manager to establish a strong handover and foundations for long-term customer success. Ongoing renewals and account expansion will transfer to the existing-business team and are not responsibilities of this role.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full new-business sales cycle from qualified opportunity through signed contract, with a focus on enterprise BrandTV opportunities.
  • Partner closely with the New Logo Hunter / BDR to progress qualified meetings into well-defined sales opportunities and maintain clear next steps.
  • Conduct high-quality discovery to understand business objectives, communication challenges, current-state technology, stakeholders, decision process and commercial drivers.
  • Confidently deliver consultative BrandTV demonstrations tailored to the customer's use case, buyer, vertical and desired outcomes rather than relying on a generic product pitch.
  • Build and manage relationships with senior stakeholders, including VP and C-level decision-makers, across Internal Communications, Executive Communications, Corporate Communications, Employee Experience and related functions.
  • Develop compelling proposals and business cases that articulate the value of BrandTV across the platform, live experience, VOD, production and creative ecosystem.
  • Manage commercial negotiations, procurement and internal approvals through to close, leveraging internal resources to accelerate the sales process and mitigate risk.
  • Maintain accurate, timely and transparent opportunity management in HubSpot, including qualification, stakeholders, stage, close date, next steps, value and forecast.
  • Build and maintain a disciplined pipeline of new-logo opportunities in line with Brandlive's commercial targets and sales methodology.
  • Conduct ongoing market and account research to identify high-fit enterprise accounts, relevant buying triggers, priority personas and competitive dynamics.
  • Work closely with Solutions, Production, Creative and other internal teams to shape the right solution and ensure the opportunity is commercially and operationally viable.
  • Develop a clear transition plan for every new customer and partner with the Account Director and Customer Success Manager through the initial 6–12 month period to ensure a high-quality handover.
  • Contribute to sales best-practice sharing, messaging development, objection handling, battle cards and continuous improvement of the Brandlive/BrandTV sales motion.

Qualifications

  • Proven track record of selling net-new enterprise software, technology or technology-enabled services.
  • Experience owning complex, consultative sales cycles from qualification through contract close.
  • Experience selling to VP and C-level stakeholders and navigating complex buying committees.
  • Strong discovery, consultative selling, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Confident delivering tailored product and solution demonstrations to different stakeholders and business audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to build pipeline, create urgency and progress opportunities through a multi-month sales cycle.
  • Strong commercial judgement and ability to build a compelling business case around customer outcomes and value.
  • Highly organised, disciplined and accurate in CRM and pipeline management.
  • Self-motivated, resilient and comfortable operating in a high-accountability new-business environment.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and willingness to build a new sales motion, test approaches and continuously improve.
  • Strong written and verbal professional communication skills in English.
  • Experience in events, streaming, SaaS, internal communications, employee experience or a related technology/service environment is desirable.
