raw.description:
The Sr. Product Manager – Battery Cabinet Solutions is responsible for the commercial lifecycle of UPS battery cabinet solutions designed for hyperscale, colocation, and Neocloud data centers, artificial intelligence (AI)/High-Performance Computing (HPC) environments, and related critical power markets. This role owns and executes the product roadmap from concept through end-of-life, drives product line financial performance and ensures solution competitiveness in global markets. This role engages directly with customers, UPS OEMs, and channel partners, serving as a sales support resource, and spearheading cross-functional alignment around the battery cabinet solutions and associated monitoring and accessory products. The position reports to the Director of Product Management and may be worked remotely from home, or at ZincFive headquarters located in Tualatin, Oregon.

Sr. Product Manager – Battery Cabinet Solutions Job Duties:

  • Conduct market research and competitive analyses; bring the voice of the customer to the organization; generate product strategy as well as working with the applications engineering team to develop product concepts and MRDs (Market Requirement Documents) for roadmap projects
  • Develop and maintain product roadmaps through working and aligning with multiple stakeholders
  • Analyze customer and market needs and business challenges, including evolving UPS architectures and AI/HPC load profiles, and recommend future product direction to business management
  • Partner with cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, applications engineering, program management, R&D, engineering, and customers to translate business opportunities into MRDs
  • Work closely with the team to ensure that product requirements are understood and communicated to stakeholders for final approval prior to execution
  • Support program management to ensure on-time delivery of specific milestones and prevent project scope creep
  • Partner with all levels of sales, marketing, and engineering staff on technology and industry related issues specifically around UPS battery cabinet solutions, UPS compatibility and integration, and nickel-zinc battery technology
  • Apply in-depth skills and broad knowledge of the business to address complex problems and non-standard situations
  • Quickly adapt to fluid situations and keep focused on delivering on goals and commitments
  • Support the ZincFive product lifecycle management process for all product management and marketing deliverables in each phase gate
  • Strive to understand others’ opinions and build agreement among team members; utilize others’ ideas and suggestions to shape solutions rather than open-ended conversations
  • Act as the product evangelist to build awareness and understanding through conferences, industry events, and publications; participate actively in relevant industry organizations and standards bodies globally
  • Support digital marketing and PR groups from a technical product perspective
  • Utilize marketing skills to develop position statements; feature-advantage-benefit statements; product pricing; collateral content and business cases, and revenue targets for product lines
  • Work with global UPS OEM, channel, and integration partners to qualify, integrate, and offer ZincFive battery cabinet solutions
  • Develop and maintain all sales tools, sales training material, and marketing collateral for assigned products in coordination with engineering
  • Create and execute sales training programs for direct sales and channel partners
  • Create and execute new product launch plans as well as promotional programs for existing products in coordination with all stakeholders
  • Act as the primary resource outside of the sales organization for sales support on assigned products; Coordinate timely responses to sales inquiries with other team members and organizations as needed

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, power electronics, electrochemistry, or equivalent years of experience
  • 5-7+ years experience in market research, product definition, and developing competitive advantages
  • 5-7+ years experience in battery and DC systems for backup in data center and related critical power markets ranging from kW to MW power levels, including UPS battery cabinets and battery packs
  • UPS and power electronics knowledge and product management experience
  • Experience with various battery chemistries (e.g., VRLA, lithium-ion, nickel-zinc) and their application in UPS backup systems
  • Experience writing product specifications including product concepts, Marketing Requirements Documents, and data sheets
  • Experience in technical product management involving senior level stakeholders
  • Strong presentation skills to create and present to diverse audiences including technical and executive levels
  • Experience managing relationships with internal stakeholders and external customers
  • Proficiency in MS Office Suite and MS Project and various software applications
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills
  • Detail oriented and organized
  • Ability to travel as needed, up to 10-20% domestic and internationally

Preferred Experience/Skills:

  • Advanced degree, MS in Engineering or MBA
  • Experience with UPS OEM products and battery cabinet integration, including UPS compatibility qualification
  • Knowledge of safety standards and certifications for stationary battery systems (e.g., UL 1973, UL 9540A, IEC 62040)
  • Battery monitoring system (BMS) and control logic experience
  • Experience supporting full product life cycles

Key Competencies:

  • Attention to detail and accuracy
  • Organizational and time management
  • Excellent communication skills – verbal, written and presentation
  • Good judgment and solid decision making
  • Teamwork and collaboration

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Work involves sitting, standing, occasional walking, and lifting up to 30 pounds
  • Ability to wear Personal Protective Equipment when required
  • Requires the ability to travel by air, car, train, or bus
  • Manufacturing, warehouse, lab, and office environments
  • Must be able to maintain a level state of alertness while performing this job

Salary offers will depend on factors that include the location you work from, your level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience and comparison to other employees already in this role.

In addition, the successful candidate for this position will become eligible for a comprehensive set of outstanding benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401k, paid sick time, paid time off for vacation, paid holidays, paid community service days, professional/personal learning program, and applicable state/federal paid family leave.

As an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status. We maintain a safe workplace and perform pre-employment testing. OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients form the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. About CarbonCure Technologies

CarbonCure Technologies
is a fast-growing carbon utilization technology company on a mission to reduce embodied carbon in new concrete construction. With hundreds of carbon mineralization systems operating worldwide, CarbonCure’s technologies inject and permanently embed captured CO₂ in concrete while also enabling reductions of carbon-intensive cement from each truckload of concrete. This innovative solution has saved hundreds of thousands of metric tons of CO₂ to date, and that impact grows with every truckload of concrete our producer partners supply in their markets. CarbonCure’s cutting-edge research and innovation have also garnered global recognition and prestigious awards, most notably the Carbon XPRIZE Grand Prize and induction into the Cleantech 100 Hall of Fame. CarbonCure’s investors include Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Blue Earth Capital, BDC, Amazon, Taronga Ventures, 2150, Microsoft, Samsung Ventures, BH3 Growth Equity, Carbon Direct, GreenSoil Investments and Mitsubishi Corporation. Follow CarbonCure on
LinkedIn.

Our Culture

Our team is made up of energetic, entrepreneurial individuals who are passionate about driving meaningful solutions to combat climate change. Besides being dedicated to our mission, we believe in work-life balance and active involvement in our local communities. We value integrity and accountability; and our core values include customer success, earned trust, data-driven decisions, and straight-talk. We don’t take ourselves too seriously, but we are here to change the world.

Purpose Driven Position

Reporting to the VP, APAC & EMEA, the Technical Manager is responsible for leading, developing, and coordinating technical operations across the Asia‑Pacific region to ensure successful installation, service delivery, and long-term customer success for CarbonCure’s solution. This role oversees both internal technical staff and external distributor partners, ensuring operational consistency, high-quality execution, and continuous improvement across all markets in the APAC sales region.

The Technical Manager, APAC, serves as the primary regional contact for technical strategy, installation excellence, equipment reliability, concrete performance, and regulatory enablement, playing a crucial role in CarbonCure’s growth and customer satisfaction throughout the APAC region.

This is a remote position, with preference for candidates located inJapan, South Korea, or Taiwanfor proximity to customer sites.

What you'll be doing

Regional Technical Team Leadership:

  • Lead and manage day-to-day activities of regional technical staff, consultants, and distributor field technicians across Singapore, Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, and emerging markets.
  • Provide hands-on leadership through coaching, site visits, and performance feedback to ensure consistent quality and adherence to CarbonCure standards.
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive technical competency program, including onboarding and training for employees, distributors, and third-party partners.
  • Establish and reinforce best practices for safety, installation, troubleshooting, concrete testing, and customer communication.

Customer Success & Technical Execution:

  • Own and execute on the regional technical strategy in alignment with APAC roadmaps for Japan, Singapore, South Korea, and additional developing markets.
  • Lead technical delivery for stages 2–5 of our Value Stream Map (VSM), including:
    • Pre‑installation planning and scheduling
    • On‑site installations and commissioning
    • Ongoing preventive maintenance
    • Concrete validation testing (both in laboratory and field)
    • Optimization of system performance and carbon credit revenue
  • Manage relationships and workflows with third‑party labs to support testing requirements for cement validation.
  • Oversee limited‑resource service models in smaller markets such as Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam, and Hong Kong, ensuring reliable customer support and escalation paths.
  • Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives to elevate service levels, reduce downtime, and standardize processes across the region.

Operational Excellence:

  • Establish and refine regional equipment assembly, refurbishment, and maintenance capabilities to reduce lead times and enhance reliability.
  • Develop and sustain a vetted network of equipment vendors, service providers, and concrete technicians, particularly in high‑priority markets.
  • Oversee technical planning and forecasting, ensuring the region delivers on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to installation output, uptime, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with R&D and Engineering teams to provide field insights that influence product design, quality improvements, and operational improvements.

Regulatory & Market Development:

  • Lead APAC regulatory strategies, including obtaining and maintaining certifications such as JIS (Japan), KS (Korea), and other standards required for new and existing market entry.
  • Support and participate in industry engagement initiatives and customer advocacy groups.
  • In collaboration with the VP, APAC & EMEA, conduct market assessments for expansion opportunities in other regions, outlining technical requirements, risks, and operational needs for successful entry.
  • Represent CarbonCure at technical symposiums, regulatory meetings, and partner discussions as a regional subject-matter expert.

This role will require travel throughout the APAC region, up to 50%.

What you'll need to succeed

  • Strong technical foundation in concrete mix design management. Experience in hardware engineering, industrial equipment, software systems, and field service operations are additional assets.
  • Proven leadership experience managing distributed technical teams across multiple countries and cultures.
  • Prior experience in the concrete, construction, or industrial equipment sector.
  • Familiarity with construction-related regulatory approval processes; experience with JIS, KS, or similar standards is an asset.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to execute operational tasks while contributing to long-term regional growth initiatives.
  • Exceptional communication skills and the ability to work effectively with sales, technical services, engineering & product development.
  • Bilingual capabilities, must speak Japanese and English; additional APAC languages are an asset (e.g. Korean, Cantonese).
  • Valid passport and willingness to travel up to 50%.

We are changing the world. Join us!

Closing Statement

We would like to thank all applicants for their interest. Please note only those selected for an interview will be contacted. If you feel passionate about this opportunity and believe that you have the skills to excel in this role, apply! Or if this sounds like someone you know, please share this posting.

We want you to know that you can be a great candidate even if you don't fit everything we've described above. You can also have important skills we haven't thought of. You will deliver in-depth product demonstrations and presentations, design customized solutions based on customer requirements, act as the technical resource for Account Executives throughout the deal, and keep our demo environments and knowledge resources current and ready to go. You report to the Manager/Director, Solutions Engineering and work closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to bring the right technical story to every opportunity.

A Day in the Life

  • Deliver in-depth product demonstrations and presentations that show the value and capabilities of our products, often across multiple opportunities in the same week.

  • Stay current on our product features, association and nonprofit technology trends, competitive products, and emerging tools.

· Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

raw.description:
About Rouge Care

Rouge Care is a premium red light therapy company building the future of health technology through clinically inspired wellness devices, software, and design. We're looking for a Head of Marketing to own the brand, the demand engine, and the one number that decides whether we grow profitably.

Role Overview

The Head of Marketing owns marketing at Rouge Care end to end — brand, creative, paid acquisition, lifecycle, content and earned media, and the measurement behind all of it. You lead a small in-house team plus a freelance creative layer, you own the budget, and you sit on the leadership team. This is a head-of-department seat, not a channel specialist role: you set the plan, you make the calls, and you are accountable for the outcome.

A few things make this different from a standard DTC marketing seat. Rouge Care is a modern wellness brand, not a device company — spec-sheet marketing is off-brand, and the work is helping people feel, perform, recover, and age better. Our economics are acquisition-led: most customers buy once, come back for accessories, and upgrade when a new hardware generation earns it. That means CAC has to pay back on the first order, and the real levers are AOV, referral, owned content, and long-cycle nurture — not a 90-day repeat rate. And we sell in six markets, with the US as the largest.

You'll be measured on one number: blended MER, anchored to contribution margin, with new-customer CAC and payback as the leading indicators. We run on EOS — weekly Level 10, quarterly Rocks, a scorecard — and you'll bring that discipline into the marketing team.

Reports directly to the COO.

What You'll Own

Brand & Creative

  • Own the positioning and the message: what Rouge Care stands for, in the words customers actually use, consistently across every market and channel.
  • Direct the creative engine — creative strategy, in-house and freelance creative talent, and a testing pipeline that produces enough volume to learn fast without diluting the brand.
  • Hold the premium bar. Every ad, email, and page should look and sound like a wellness brand people trust, not a hardware spec sheet.

Paid Acquisition & Performance

  • Own the paid media plan and budget across Meta, Google, TikTok, and marketplace advertising, and the split between awareness and conversion spend.
  • Lead the media buying team to scale new-customer acquisition profitably, judged on true MER and payback — not platform-reported ROAS.
  • Open and scale new markets with a repeatable playbook: localization, offers, creative, and channel mix that transfer cleanly from one country to the next.

Lifecycle & Owned Channels

  • Own email and SMS (Klaviyo) as a revenue channel: flows, campaigns, segmentation, and the long-cycle nurture that keeps customers engaged between hardware generations.
  • Grow revenue per customer — bundles, accessories and stands, upgrade campaigns at each new launch, referral, and reviews.
  • Build the launch playbook with Product so every new generation, accessory, and software feature lands with a full go-to-market plan.

Content, Community & Earned Media

  • Lead PR, organic social, creator and influencer programs, community, and SEO/AEO as a coherent visibility engine, not a set of side projects.
  • Make our science and our customers' results the story: education-led content that earns trust before the first click.
  • Partner with Sales and Strategic Partnerships on B2B, practitioner, and corporate wellness marketing so the brand shows up consistently everywhere it sells.

Web, CRO & Measurement

  • Own the Shopify storefront and PDPs as conversion assets, with a standing CRO cadence and a clear view of what the top competitors are doing better.
  • Own the marketing dashboard and attribution stack (Triple Whale and first-party data): MER, CAC, contribution by channel and by cohort, reported weekly and trusted by the leadership team.
  • Run the marketing operating rhythm — annual calendar, quarterly plan, weekly scorecard, budget and forecast — so the department runs on a system rather than on you.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years in DTC or e-commerce marketing, with at least 3 years leading a team and owning a P&L-level number (MER, CAC, or contribution margin).
  • Proven track record scaling paid social and search profitably on seven-figure annual budgets, with a clear-eyed view of incrementality and attribution.
  • Experience with premium, considered-purchase products — high AOV, long consideration cycles. Wellness, health-tech, or consumer hardware is a strong plus.
  • Brand instinct and performance discipline in the same person: you can direct a creative and read a cohort analysis in the same afternoon.
  • A builder of teams and systems — hiring, briefing, managing freelancers, and running a weekly cadence that makes the team better without you in every room.
  • AI-native marketer who uses AI tooling instinctively for creative volume, research, analysis, and speed.
  • Comfortable working autonomously in a remote environment, taking ownership, and moving fast.
  • Bonus: Klaviyo, Shopify, and Triple Whale; Amazon marketing; multi-country expansion; experience operating inside EOS.
  • Bonus: bilingual French/English (Montreal headquarters).

Benefits

  • Remote-first work environment
  • 4 weeks vacation
  • 5 personal/sick days
  • Group insurance
  • RRSP matching up to $5,000
  • $500 annual health & wellness flex allowance
  • Legendary Christmas party

raw.excerpt: Company DescriptionZayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society.
raw.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Program Manager, Long Haul OSP Deployment

The Program Manager, Long Haul OSP Deployment is responsible for the successful delivery of long haul fiber deployment programs through direct management of turnkey engineering and construction contractors and oversight of multiple concurrent projects.


This role combines strategic program leadership with hands-on project execution responsibilities, ensuring projects ($100mm+) are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with Zayo quality standards.


The Program Manager serves as the primary operational and contractual interface between Zayo, turnkey vendors, and customers. This position is accountable for contract administration, project controls, budget management, regulatory compliance, contractor performance, risk mitigation, and project closeout activities across a portfolio of long haul network expansion projects.


The Program Manager reports to the Director, Long Haul OSP Deployment.


Key Responsibilities

Program & Project Leadership

  • Lead the delivery of multiple long haul OSP deployment projects simultaneously, including greenfield, overpull, and network expansion initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, schedules, budgets, and resource forecasts.
  • Drive project execution from initial planning through engineering, permitting, construction, testing, acceptance, and closeout.
  • Monitor project performance against scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.
  • Identify project risks and implement mitigation and recovery plans to maintain delivery commitments.

Contractor & Vendor Management

  • Serve as the primary contractual and operational interface with turnkey engineering and construction partners.
  • Draft, review, negotiate, and administer engineering and construction contracts.
  • Monitor contractor compliance with contractual requirements, milestone commitments, production targets, safety standards, and quality expectations.
  • Conduct contractor performance reviews and drive accountability through structured reporting, corrective action plans, and executive escalations when required.
  • Review and approve contractor invoices, production reports, schedules, and change orders.

Contract Administration & Financial Management

  • Manage project budgets, capital expenditures, forecasts, and financial reporting.
  • Evaluate and process change orders, assessing impacts to project scope, cost, and schedule.
  • Validate quantities, unit pricing, schedule-of-values reporting, and contractor invoicing.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, contract records, correspondence, and audit-ready project files.
  • Provide regular financial and operational updates to leadership and key stakeholders.

Engineering, Permitting & Regulatory Oversight

  • Collaborate with Fiber Engineering to validate route design, constructability, fiber assignments, and project requirements.
  • Oversee engineering package development, permitting strategies, and regulatory compliance activities.
  • Manage complex permitting and environmental requirements, including NEPA, Section 106, Tribal engagement, right-of-way negotiations, state utility commissions, and federal funding requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with NTIA and other government-funded program requirements, including Davis-Bacon, BABA, and environmental assessment obligations.

Construction & Material Management

  • Oversee contractor material forecasting, procurement coordination, receiving, inventory tracking, and field deployment activities.
  • Monitor field production rates and construction progress against established schedules.
  • Support resolution of field issues impacting schedule, cost, quality, or customer commitments.
  • Ensure adherence to OSP construction standards, fiber specifications, testing requirements, and safety practices.

Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

  • Deliver project-level, program-level, and executive-level reporting, including progress updates, financial summaries, risk assessments, and recovery plans.
  • Maintain proactive communication with customers, internal stakeholders, contractors, and leadership teams.
  • Facilitate issue resolution across cross-functional teams to minimize project impacts.
  • Present project status and recommendations to Program leadership and customer stakeholders.

Testing, Acceptance & Closeout

  • Oversee fiber testing, acceptance, and closeout processes to ensure compliance with Zayo standards.
  • Review and validate project deliverables, as-built documentation, redlined network diagrams, and inventory updates.
  • Ensure timely delivery of complete project closeout packages to GIS, Operations, Network Engineering, and Inventory teams.
  • Verify that all project documentation, testing records, permits, and customer deliverables are complete and accurately archived.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead, mentor, and develop project managers and deployment personnel as assigned.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and implement best practices for contractor management, project controls, reporting, and long haul deployment execution.
  • Partner with regional and functional teams to align deployment strategies with broader network objectives.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Telecommunications, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • Equivalent industry experience may be substituted for formal education.

Experience

  • Minimum of eight (8) years of telecommunications, fiber deployment, or OSP project management experience.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years managing complex outside plant construction projects and contractor relationships.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering multimillion-dollar fiber deployment projects on schedule and within budget.
  • Experience administering engineering, construction, and turnkey (EPC) contracts.
  • Experience managing federal and state regulatory requirements, permitting, and environmental compliance.
  • Prior leadership experience managing project teams or cross-functional deployment organizations preferred.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong knowledge of OSP construction methods, fiber optic infrastructure, and long haul network architecture.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including financial modeling, budget forecasting, data analysis, reporting, pivot tables, lookups, and project performance tracking.
  • Understanding of fiber testing standards, acceptance requirements, and closeout procedures.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, route maps, construction packages, and testing documentation.
  • Familiarity with GIS platforms, Google Earth, and network inventory systems.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce, Sitetracker, and project management systems preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong contract negotiation and administration skills.
  • Excellent financial management, forecasting, and budgeting capabilities.
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

raw.description:
O que vamos construir juntos?

  • Estamos em busca de uma pessoa DevOps Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico e internacional, apoiando um momento importante de mudança e reestruturação tecnológica;
  • Esse profissional terá papel essencial na condução das transformações da área, trabalhando de forma próxima às equipes de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura;
  • Você fará parte do time de DI, atuando em um time enxuto e altamente técnico, atualmente composto por 4 pessoas, com grande autonomia e impacto direto nas decisões de arquitetura e infraestrutura.
  • Projetar, implementar e manter soluções de infraestrutura em nuvem, principalmente na AWS, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e performance;
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD automatizados, assegurando entregas de software rápidas e confiáveis;
  • Criar e manter Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) utilizando Packer e Terraform, garantindo consistência nos deploys;
  • Configurar e otimizar workloads Kubernetes, principalmente no AWS EKS, para suportar aplicações containerizadas;
  • Construir e manter estruturas de monitoramento, logging e alertas, garantindo a observabilidade dos sistemas e a resolução proativa de problemas;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de desenvolvimento, garantindo soluções seguras, modulares e bem documentadas nas camadas de aplicação, rede e infraestrutura;
  • Escrever e manter documentação técnica, promovendo excelência operacional e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida atuando como DevOps ou função similar;
  • Vivência prática com AWS e Kubernetes;
  • Experiência com CI/CD (GitHub Actions);
  • Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (Packer e Terraform);
  • Domínio de fluxos de trabalho com Git;
  • Domínio de scripts (Bash, Python ou similares);
  • Entendimento de IAM (Identity and Access Management);
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração para atuação em times multidisciplinares;
  • Inglês avançado para fluente para atuação no projeto internacional.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com outras ferramentas de CI/CD, como ArgoCD ou Octopus Deploy;
  • Experiência na construção de estruturas de observabilidade com ferramentas como Prometheus ou Datadog;
  • Conhecimento avançado em configurações de rede em ambientes cloud;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Forte foco em boas práticas de segurança nas camadas de aplicação, rede e infraestrutura;
  • Capacidade de desenhar sistemas modulares, bem documentados e com alta cobertura de testes.

Informações adicionais

  • Vale iFood (alimentação e refeição);
  • Aux. Home Office;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Day off de Aniversário;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade estendida;
  • Parcerias Educacionais;
  • Parceria Total Pass - saúde e bem estar;
  • Parceria Clude Saúde;
  • Programas de Reembolso;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Dresscode: seja você.

raw.description:
SailPoint is the leader in Identity Security. SailPoint customers represent half of the Fortune 500 and half of the ASX 50. This customer strength provides us with a great community of customers, partners and analysts who trust SailPoint and our team to solve complex challenges. SailPoint continues to grow globally and expanding our global presence creates opportunities for top salespeople to become a part of our awesome culture.

We are recognized by analysts such as Gartner, Forester and Kuppinger Cole as the leader in the market and we continue to push ourselves to define the market rather than follow what the analysts or competitors are marketing.Organizations struggle to understand who has access to what applications and data, and we help them answer these key questions. Identity security is the central control point for risk management for the enterprise.

We are proud of our team and the culture we have built which has led to our employees voting us “best places to work” – 15 years in a row.

The role:

We are seeking anAccount Executive, to sell our Identity Security Solution.

To excel, the position requires an account executive:

  • Who is a skilled communicator in first engagements and discovery callsanalyzingthe prospects needs to qualify an opportunity.

  • Who will be highly proficient in understanding and presenting the value of SailPoint solutions and how they compare to Microsoft, Okta, and Saviynt.

  • Who will provide a superior customer experience from the first discovery call and leverage their skills in competitively positioning our solutions and a broader value proposition including partnerservices.

  • Who can lead a virtual team of partner resources, presales, partner manager, deal desk, professional services, BVA team, and customer success to deliver sales wins and customer success.

  • Who does notoperate independently, instead sells as a team.

  • Who can act as the quarterback; take initiative and prep the team on what is needed from them priorto calls.

  • Who can make good decisions about whoshould engage and whenand make people accountable for following through.

  • Who can create a territory or opportunity plan, which includes the steps you believe are required to get from discovery to the next steps in the sales cycle.

  • Who will work closely with the leadership team to refine your ideas and make your sales strategy as effective as possible.

Responsibilities:

  • Effectively address each customer’s and partner’s unique inquiries by providing accurate information and tailored solutions that align with their specific needs and interests.

    through/with partners and end users.

  • Pursue all leads supplied and ensure internal systems are updated.

  • Lead the appropriate technical resources to demonstrate SailPoint's advantages to the customer.

  • Follow-up with customers and partner with post-sale teamto
    ensure consistent and ongoing coverage of account, including new sales

    opportunities.

  • Own and oversee all aspects of the sales cycle, including qualifying,
    presentations, demonstrations, RFP responses, negotiations, and the closing

    process.

  • Fosters a deep understanding of the territory,includingcustomers, prospects, partners, influencers, and competitors.

  • Understand and communicate all product and technological strategies
    employed by competitive and complimentary organizations in the SailPoint market space.

  • Effectively initiate, navigate, and manage discussions across all levels of a customer’s organization, from business stakeholders to technical decision-makers.

  • Utilize all channel management and reporting tools, including accurate forecasting and Salesforce hygiene.

The path to success:

1-month milestones:

  • Establish plan for existing customers clearly identifying opportunities for uplift over coming years and understanding account potential.

  • Segment account list into your top 20 focused accounts & the Top 3 Big Bet accounts within this list.

  • Meet with old account managers to capture any history.

  • Meet with partners of existing accounts to understand their position and services offered.

  • Work with Marketing Manager on marketing plan.

  • Work with Channel Manager on channel plan.

2-month milestones:

  • Create a stakeholder map for key partners that are influencers in
    your Top 20 accounts and devise your approach to connect with them.

  • DemonstrateSalesforce hygiene with regular, accurate activity and

    updates.

  • Met weekly with sales management to keep Salesforce and Clari up to date.

3-month milestones:

  • Complete territory plan andpresent to Sales Management:

  • Existing account overview and account potential

  • Prioritized accounts with account potential

  • Clean pipeline of potential 2025 opportunities to establishgap to target

  • Marketing and channel engagement plans to close the Gap to target

  • Customer references / case studies planned

  • Pipeline growth plan

  • Meet with all existing customers and identify opportunities to extend the value they arereceiving from SailPoint.

  • Lead an operating cadence with virtual team

  • Achieve “1st Mate” enablement badge.

4-month milestones:

  • Create account plans for key accounts.

  • Create opportunity plans for key opportunities.

  • Present forecast for self-generated opportunity & expected time to 1st

    sale.

  • Develop strategies to approach Top 20 accounts - present to

    management.

  • Relationship maps in Salesforce are completed - customers from Top 20 accounts know who you are.

  • Showing progress through sales stages for any inbound/inherited opportunities (sales cycle5-40).

  • Present SailPoint value proposition in front of manager via either:customer / prospect or internally.

6-month milestones:

  • Built a Pipeline of 2 to 3 times target comprising.

  • Existing customer pipeline

  • Progress existing pipeline

  • New Pipeline

  • Refine “go to market” for this market segment highlighting key messaging when competing with Microsoft and Okta, benefits of working with partner, pricing challenges, etc.

  • Complete your Captains badge on HighSpot.

Education:
Preferred but not required: Bachelor's degree or global equivalent in an IT, business or sales related field.

Travel:
Business travel of approximately 50 percent yearly is expected for this position.

As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the SailPoint Corporate Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission, along with potential eligibility for equity participation. raw.title: Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) - Plymouth, MA
raw.excerpt: Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
raw.description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.

  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

Communitas operates in over 20 different countries as we start new initiatives and nurture churches and church-planting projects toward reproducible maturity.

Communitas is rooted in missional theology. Our three core values center on being Kingdom seeking, Grace oriented and People focused. Our church planting methodology is not tied to a specific formula, but rather the spirit of serving others and the embracing of a progression of actions that lead to a healthy, maturing church, making our approach very adaptable to unique contexts (see for details). We are pioneers and risk takers. We value honesty and encouragement. We collaborate well, within our global regions, as well as with partner organizations.

The Need and Opportunity

Across post-Christian secular culture people have largely given up on church, but spirituality remains important to them. Communitas International is at the forefront of sparking that spirituality with mission and helping people ‘taste and see that the Lord is good’. Our church planting organization offers the following:

  • A firm commitment to expressing the passionate love of God for the world in word and deed.
  • Substantial experience in reaching people in post-Christian culture.
  • Strategic coaching for planters and churches by experienced cross-cultural practitioners.
  • Robust training for team leaders and members via online cohorts, on-site events and regional/global seminars and conferences.
  • Rigorous assessment experiences and tools that can form the basis for strategic coaching and healthy team building.
  • Partnership in innovation with those looking for new ways to declare the timeless message of the Gospel.

Videographer

Reports to:

Chief Multiplication Officer

Works closely with:

Mobilization, Human Resources, Global field leaders, Field staff

Direct reports:

None

Location:

Remote work engagement

Structure:

Full-time, part-time, bi-vocational (support-raised); volunteer

Position Scope:

The Videographer will use video production and visual storytelling to strengthen Communitas’ brand, expand audience engagement, and share the stories of what God is doing through our ministry partners and communities around the world.

This position is responsible for creating compelling video content from concept development through final production, including planning, directing, filming, editing, and distributing video projects across digital platforms.

Principal Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Produce, direct, film, and edit professional-quality video projects for web, social media, ministry communications, and other platforms.
  • Capture interviews, events, ministry activities, and environmental footage that authentically represent the work of Communitas.
  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of video production equipment, software, and industry best practices.
  • Develop creative concepts, story ideas, scripts, and production plans that communicate Communitas’ mission effectively.
  • Work directly with project leaders and community members across diverse cultural settings.
  • Travel to ministry locations, churches, and project sites to capture firsthand stories and experiences.
  • Set up and operate live-streaming equipment and platforms as needed for events and ministry communications.
  • Support and train missionaries in effective video capture techniques.
  • Capture creative still photography to support Communitas’ communications and marketing efforts.

General Responsibilities:

  • Demonstrates spiritual maturity and a growing relationship with Jesus Christ.
  • Aligns fully with the mission, vision, values, and Statement of Faith of Communitas.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, discretion, and integrity in all matters.
  • Maintains a collaborative, learning-oriented, and positive leadership posture.
  • Commits to excellence in communication, stewardship, and organizational representation.

Qualifications:

  • Be a committed follower of Jesus Christ with a strong alignment with the mission, vision, and values of Communitas.
  • Demonstrate a passion for ministry, storytelling, and using creative gifts to serve others.
  • Be a collaborative team member who works well with diverse groups of people.
  • Be adaptable, willing to experiment, evaluate, and adjust creative approaches when needed.
  • Hold a bachelor's degree in cinematography, broadcasting, communications, media production, or related field (preferred).
  • Demonstrate strong video production, filming, editing, and post-production skills.
  • Possess extensive knowledge of video formats and delivery methods for web and mobile platforms.
  • Understand the technical requirements and equipment needed for professional video production.
  • Have strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Be able to manage multiple projects, prioritize deadlines, and work effectively in a changing environment.
  • Be willing and able to travel as ministry opportunities require.

Funding:

The salary and ministry-related expenses associated with this position are funded through personal support raising. Candidates may serve in this role through a traditional full-time ministry position, part-time role, bi-vocational arrangement, or volunteer capacity. Communitas provides onboarding, training, coaching, and ongoing support to help team members build and sustain a healthy ministry partnership team.

Communitas welcomes applicants who feel called to use their creative skills to advance the Gospel through visual storytelling.

Position Summary:

The Account Director will serve as a strategic leader, managing key client and Rosie relationships and ensuring the successful delivery of marketing talent and marketing/creative services. This role demands a blend of strategic thinking, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to juggle multiple priorities to achieve outstanding client outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

Client and Rosie Advocacy:

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned clients, ensuring open communication and trust.
  • Conduct regular client status meetings to review progress, address concerns, and discuss new opportunities.
  • Support implementation and maintain the processes and systems needed to manage complex client partnerships—coordinating multiple Rosies, timelines, scopes, and account details with clarity and consistency.
  • Act as the primary point of contact and partner for working Rosies on assigned projects, including coaching and performance feedback.
  • Represent the client’s needs internally, ensuring deliverables (projects or talent) align with their goals and vision.
  • Act as the key liaison between clients and internal teams, ensuring feedback is translated into actionable insights and deliverables aligned with the client’s vision.
  • Ensure campaigns and deliverables consistently meet or exceed client expectations.
  • Foster a strong Rosie community across active engagements—creating connection, shared best practices, and ongoing touchpoints that drive satisfaction and retention.

Strategic Account Management & Oversight:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and partner to clients by developing marketing and/or talent strategies that align with their business objectives and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Act as the key liaison between clients and internal/Rosie teams, ensuring feedback is translated into actionable insights and deliverables stay aligned with the client’s vision/objective/direction.
  • Address and resolve client concerns promptly, demonstrating a commitment to exceptional service.
  • Develop and present post-campaign/project/placement reviews to clients, showcasing results, lessons learned, and opportunities for further strategic initiatives.

Proactively identify risks, gaps, and blockers—then lead structured problem-solving across clients, Rosies, and internal teams to keep work on track and outcomes strong.

Rosie Casting and Matchmaking:

  • Identify, match and vet talent to meet specific client needs for marketing and creative projects.
  • Collaborate with key XFN partners to deliver the optimal Rosie journey from client briefing, matchmaking/vetting, and project execution.
  • Monitor project progress, addressing potential risks and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality talent for Matched By services.
  • Ensure adherence to WRR processes, maintaining consistency and efficiency in talent and project delivery

    Financial Management:
  • Manage account budgets for Matched By services, ensuring talent is delivered on time and within scope.
  • Track, analyze, and report on utilization and budget status to support clients in budget management.
  • Negotiate and develop project scopes in collaboration with the appropriate team members to ensure mutually beneficial terms.

Drive Organic Revenue Growth:

  • Identify and pursue upsell or cross-sell opportunities to expand client accounts while maintaining retention goals.
  • Identify opportunities to expand client engagements, such as pitching additional services and projects.
  • Deliver consistently excellent client service to build trust, strengthen relationships, and create momentum for account growth.

Team Leadership and Collaboration:

  • Mentor and develop Account Executive(s), fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture.
  • Collaborate with internal teams during talent matchmaking, onboarding, and offboarding, ensuring smooth and successful transitions for both the client and Rosies.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in account management within an agency or brand in-house agency.
  • Proven track record of managing multiple client accounts and delivering results.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and manage cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in project management tools and CRM software.
  • A client-centric mindset with the ability to balance client needs and business objectives.

Solution-oriented self-starter with a can-do attitude—quick to learn, willing to try new things, and able to adapt as needs evolve with autonomy.


Compensation:Base salary range of $120,000 - $125,000 + quarterly variable commission based on the achievement of revenue targets, and will be paid in accordance with the current WRR Sales Incentive Plan.

Perks & Benefits

A yearly stipend for professional and personal development; 25 PTO days + 4 Volunteer PTO days per year; medical, dental, and vision insurance; remote work stipend; matching 401K; and an opportunity to join a truly incredible team at a company that is building the future of work.

OUR VALUES

Treat People Like People -Seeing the value in all people’s unique lives, experiences, and perspectives is what drives us.

Start With Why -Asking “Why” makes our team curious first so we get to better solutions. When we make a decision, we take the time to explain the “Why”’ behind our actions. Transparency is clear and it’s kind.

Speak With Actions -Trust isn’t given, it’s earned. We prove our reliability and trustworthiness to each other, our clients, and our Rosies by showing up and doing what we say we will — through small interactions and big moves.

Bring Tenacity -The path isn’t always an easy one, but our team chooses to be unwavering in our goal. We’re resilient, determined, and stubborn when necessary. That’s the fire it takes to get things done.

Make it Better -From changing old processes to disrupting the marketing industry, we know there is room to make it better. We strive to find those improvements and push them to reality.

Salary: $120,000 - $125,000

Your expertise will play a vital role in validating technical solutions, leading proofs of concept, and making persuasive arguments to senior marketing and digital leaders. By sharing valuable customer feedback with our Product teams, you will contribute to composing the future of our API and data integration features.


What You’ll Do

  • Take charge of technical solution validation, encompassing discovery, proofs of concept (POCs), and addressing objections

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Mutual of Omaha is expanding its Brand, Marketing & Communications (BMC) program to launch a newly approved, enterprise-wide Customer Communication Management (CCM) platform. This is not a backfill – it is a new role created to help build something from the ground up. The CCM platform will give our customers control over how they receive information from Mutual of Omaha, moving statements and benefit communications that were traditionally printed and mailed to secure digital delivery. The result: a better customer experience and meaningful cost savings for the company.

As the Engineering Lead for the CCM platform, you will set the technical direction and engineering standards across a set of interconnected applications – spanning greenfield development, enterprise scaling of existing applications, and integration with vendor and internal systems. You will serve as a Solution Lead, starting with a newly formed discovery team and continuing as the platform expands into dedicated delivery teams.

This role combines technical leadership with hands-on engineering (approximately 40–50% coding). The ideal candidate is an experienced solution or engineering lead who enjoys building new platforms, keeps teams honest on engineering practices, and is energized by shaping a multi-year transformation of how Mutual of Omaha communicates with its customers.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary:
    • Engineer II - $125,000 - $140,000, plus annual bonus opportunity
    • Engineer III - $150,000 - $163,000, plus annual bonus opportunity
  • Benefits and Perks: 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match
  • Time Off: Up to 15 days of vacation annually, plus 11 paid holidays including 2 floating holidays
  • Work Arrangement: Remote, with occasional in-person team events (approximately once per year for 3–4 days)
  • Eligibility: Applicants must not now, nor in the future, require employment sponsorship

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Platform Engineering Leadership: Serve as the overall engineering lead for the CCM platform, establishing and enforcing engineering standards, patterns, and practices across interconnected applications to ensure they are scalable, maintainable, and ready for future growth.
  • Solution Leadership: Act as Solution Lead for the CCM discovery team and future delivery teams, coordinating closely with other Solution Leads to align designs, dependencies, and delivery across the program.
  • Hands-On Development: Spend roughly 40–50% of your time coding – building greenfield applications and enhancing and scaling existing applications using Java, MuleSoft, and AWS.
  • Discovery & Build-vs-Buy Analysis: Assess the capabilities and gaps of existing applications, estimate the effort to make them enterprise-ready, and evaluate vendor solutions to recommend where to build versus buy. Findings will directly shape the 2027 critical path plan.
  • Platform Capabilities: Help design and deliver core CCM capabilities, including a decision engine, a customer consent and preference center, workflow management, and analytics tracking – along with integrations to Salesforce and third-party tools.
  • Mentorship & Collaboration: Mentor and guide engineers on the team and partner with QA, business analysts, and technical leadership within a SAFe Agile environment (three-week sprints, quarterly PI planning).
  • AI-Enabled Engineering: Champion the use of AI tools and agents to accelerate development, improve code quality, and increase team productivity.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience as a Solution Lead, Engineering Lead, or Technical Lead.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and AWS cloud services.
  • Experience with MuleSoft or similar integration platforms, including API design and system-to-system integration.
  • Proven track record of building applications from scratch and taking them from concept to production.
  • Experience scaling and modernizing existing applications for enterprise-wide use.
  • Ability to define and uphold engineering standards across multiple applications and teams.
  • Experience with CI/CD practices and tooling, including GitHub.
  • Experience leading and mentoring other engineers.
  • Comfortable working in SAFe Agile environments and contributing to PI planning within Agile Release Trains (ART).
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to coordinate across teams and stakeholders.

PREFERRED:

  • Experience with Vue.js.
  • Experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK.
  • Experience or strong interest in AI-assisted engineering, including using AI agents in the development process.
  • Experience with Salesforce integrations.
  • Experience with customer communication management, digital document delivery, or consent and preference management solutions.
  • Experience evaluating and implementing vendor solutions.
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience.

We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

This is a remote position.

Your IT Recruiter is looking for a skilled individual who can efficiently manage, process, and analyze payroll data. Payroll Analysts are responsible for ensuring that an organization’s employees are paid accurately and on time. They analyze and coordinate payroll processes, maintain payroll records, and perform audits to ensure accuracy.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Payroll Analysts are responsible for ensuring that an organization’s employees are paid accurately and on time. They analyze and coordinate payroll processes, maintain payroll records, and perform audits to ensure accuracy.

  • Collecting and verifying timekeeping information for all employees
  • Calculating pay according to hours worked incorporating leaves and overtime
  • Calculating bonuses and commissions when applicable
  • Managing and calculating taxes and deductions
  • Initiating periodical payments timely either by preparing and administering checks or making direct deposits through a bank payment system
  • Issuing statements and invoices and maintaining records
  • Updating paper and electronic payroll records by entering adjustments on pay rates, employee status changes etc.
  • Dealing with complaints and questions regarding payroll from employees and upper management
  • Investigating and resolving any discrepancies in payroll
  • Preparing and submitting reports with payroll information to supervisor
  • Keeping informed about changes in tax and deduction laws that apply to the payroll process
  • Coordinating with Human Resources and Accounting teams

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Proven work experience as a Payroll Analyst or similar role in the HR department.
  • Strong knowledge of labor legislation and payroll processes.
  • Experience with payroll software and MS Office (especially Excel).
  • Good math skills with the ability to spot numerical errors.
  • Attention to detail and confidentiality.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Proficiency in payroll systems and software to effectively manage payroll operations and ensure data accuracy.
  • Strong analytical skills to examine payroll data, identify discrepancies, and implement appropriate corrections.
  • Attention to detail and excellent organizational skills for maintaining precise payroll records and documents.
  • Knowledge of payroll taxes, social security, and other deductions to ensure accurate calculations and adherence to local, state, and federal laws.
  • Excellent numerical skills to manage large amounts of data and perform accurate calculations.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to communicate effectively with employees, management, and external agencies regarding payroll-related inquiries and issues.
  • Problem-solving skills to identify, investigate, and resolve payroll discrepancies and issues promptly and efficiently.
  • Proficiency in using Excel or similar software for data management and reporting.
  • Strong understanding of employment law, tax regulations, and confidentiality principles related to payroll administration.

Requirements:

  • BS degree in Finance, HR, Accounting or relevant field.
  • 3-5 years of payroll processing.
  • Must have experience with ADP

Kasha also works with manufacturers and global health organizations, operating as a service channel for visibility on distribution, performance data, consumer insights, and last-mile access. They lead the design and implementation of CI/CD workflows, infrastructure automation, and monitoring solutions, collaborating closely with development, QA, and IT teams to drive reliability, scalability, and performance in software delivery. This role also involves mentoring the team to establishing best practices in cloud infrastructure, security, and configuration management.This role can be based in Rwanda, Kenya, South Africa and/or Egypt.

  • Budgets, records, tracking and reporting inputs are complete and reliable
  • Risks and delivery concerns are escalated early
  • Stakeholders receive clear, timely and professional communication
  • Agreed utilisation and job profitability targets are met
